description: Great night at Orange County Executive Steve Neuhaus’s golf outing ⛳️ Steve has spent years showing what it means to lead with dedication, accessibility, and a genuine commitment to the people he serves. As someone beginning my own journey in public service, I hope to follow his example and be the kind of leader who’s always there to listen and work hard for the community. Thank you to Steve for everything you do for the OC! 🇺🇸
